def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    coords = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in coords), max(r for r, c in coords)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in coords), max(c for r, c in coords)

    colors = {grid[r][c] for r, c in coords}
    outer = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(grid[r][c] == v for r, c in coords))
    inner = next(v for v in colors if v != outer)

    inner_coords = [(r, c) for r, c in coords if grid[r][c] == inner]
    thickness = min(
        min(r for r, c in inner_coords) - r0,
        r1 - max(r for r, c in inner_coords),
        min(c for r, c in inner_coords) - c0,
        c1 - max(c for r, c in inner_coords)
    )

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0 - thickness), min(h, r1 + thickness + 1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0 - thickness), min(w, c1 + thickness + 1)):
            if r < r0 or r > r1 or c < c0 or c > c1:
                out[r][c] = inner
    return out

    ic0, ic1 = min(c for r, c in inner), max(c for r, c in inner)

        for c in range(max(0, c0 - distance), min(w, c1 + distance + 1)):
            if not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1):
